summary: Faz 1 File Processing Engine E2E tested. Backend pytest: 21/21 pass covering TXT/PDF/CSV/PNG uploads, list scoping (extracted_text stripped), single GET (full text), summarize + cache, ask (grounded — 750 TL retrieved from content), delete + 404, unsupported .exe → 400, 51MB → 400, empty → 400, unauth → 401/403, multi-tenant isolation (2nd user cannot see/summarize/ask/delete another user's file), and regression on /chat + /memory + /tasks + /notes + /auth/me. Frontend: after clearing localStorage, login with serkan/19071987 works, all 5 sidebar tabs render (GEÇMİŞ/GÖREVLER/HAFIZA/DOSYALAR/NOTLAR), Dosyalar tab shows FilePanel + drop zone, file upload via input succeeds, file appears in list, expand shows Özetle/Sor buttons, Özetle produces summary, Sor modal accepts question and returns grounded Turkish answer containing '750', delete removes the file, other tabs still render. Zero console errors during the flow.

issues: All 5 tab labels are truncated to ~2 characters (GE.../GÖ.../HA.../DO.../NO...) because the CSS makes each tab flex-1 and text truncates. Icons alone still allow guessing but labels are effectively unreadable until the sidebar is widened by the user. Consider (a) increasing DEFAULT_SIDEBAR_WIDTH to ~460px, (b) hiding the GripVertical icon at narrow widths so text has more room, or (c) rendering only the icon on <420px width. Not a functional bug — the data-testid selectors still work — but poor first-impression UX.

action_items: OPTIONAL DESIGN: widen the default sidebar OR shorten tab visual chrome so the 5 tab labels aren't truncated to 2 chars at default width (see design_issues).

OPTIONAL CLEANUP: 7 leftover TEST_* files from repeated pytest runs remain in serkan's file list (soft-deleted ones plus a fresh set). A background cleanup or a bulk-delete admin API would help keep the demo clean, but not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: files_router.upload_file reads the entire body into memory BEFORE the size check (file.read() then len check). For a 100 MB upload this doubles peak memory. Recommend streaming into a bounded BytesIO with an early abort when the running total exceeds MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES, or use starlette's UploadFile chunking with a size guard. Same pattern already noted for /api/stt/whisper in iteration_17.

storage_service.put_object uses synchronous `requests` inside async request handlers — this blocks the event loop for the duration of the upload (potentially many seconds for 50MB files). Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run in a threadpool with asyncio.to_thread. Same applies to get_object.

file_service.extract_content calls sync CPU-heavy libs (pypdf, openpyxl, python-docx, pptx) directly inside an async function — these will block the loop for large documents. Wrap them in asyncio.to_thread(...).

extraction status='ok' is set based purely on `bool(text and text.strip())` — an image whose vision analysis returned only whitespace would be flagged 'partial' with error 'İçerik boş' rather than showing a real vision error. Consider surfacing partial vs failed separately from LLM error stream.

files_router.upload_file has no client-visible retry / idempotency for storage 502s — if the object storage put_object fails mid-request, the DB has no record but the file might exist upstream (or not). Consider a temporary local staging directory + background move OR two-phase commit.
file_service.MAX_TEXT_CHARS = 200_000 and SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS = 60_000 are hard-coded — should be ENV-tunable and logged in the extraction record so users understand truncation.
The Ask endpoint accepts arbitrarily long questions but doesn't rate-limit — one impatient user could hammer /files/{id}/ask and burn LLM budget. Consider a token-bucket per user_id.

Sidebar.jsx / FilePanel.jsx onDelete uses window.confirm() which is a blocking browser dialog inconsistent with the rest of the app's sonner-toast UX. Prefer AlertDialog from /components/ui/alert-dialog for consistency.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: login, tabs, upload, expand, summarize, ask, delete, regression tabs)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_*.txt/pdf/csv/png files and one throwaway 'testuser_*' account (auto-deleted). Some TEST_ files remain in serkan's Files list after test runs (see action_items).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Faz 1 file processing works end-to-end: TXT/PDF/CSV/PNG upload → extraction (with GPT-5.2 Vision for images) → summarize (cached on 2nd call) → ask (grounded on content) → soft-delete. Multi-tenant isolation is enforced at every endpoint (list/get/summarize/ask/delete → 404 for non-owner). Key data-testids: tab-files, file-panel, file-drop-zone, file-upload-input, file-upload-btn, file-list, file-item-{id}, file-toggle-{id}, file-summarize-{id}, file-ask-{id}, file-ask-modal, file-ask-input, file-ask-submit, file-ask-answer, file-ask-close, file-delete-{id}. Turkish grounding works — 'Toplam gelir ne kadar?' on a file containing '750 TL' returns 'Toplam gelir 750 TL.' Login is serkan/19071987. LocalStorage keys to clear when needed: sertex_token_v1, sertex_tab_order_v1, sertex_sidebar_dims_v1. Summarize/ask each take 5-25s (LLM cold latency).
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. The 'chat still works' test initially failed only because my test assertion used the wrong response key ('reply' vs 'assistant_message.content') — I fixed the assertion, not the code, and it now passes. The rest of the design_issues (truncated tab labels) is a UX polish suggestion, not a bug.
